```{r}
plotTransVF <- function(us, analysis = NULL, labels = NULL, title = NULL){
  require(ggplot2)
  require(cowplot)
  if(is.null(analysis)){
    analysis <- names(us$Results)
  }
  if(is.null(labels)){
    for(i in analysis){
      labels <- unique(c(labels, names(us$Results[[i]]$TransitionStats)))
    }
  }
  
  ps <- list()
  for(i in analysis){
    for(j in labels[labels %in% names(us$Results[[i]]$TransitionStats)]){
      bdat <- data.frame(distance = us$Results[[i]]$TransitionStats[[j]]$bootstraps)
      dis <- us$Results[[i]]$TransitionStats[[j]]$distance
      sigma <- us$Results[[i]]$TransitionStats[[j]]$sigma
      percentile <- us$Results[[i]]$TransitionStats[[j]]$percentile
      p1 <- ggplot(bdat,aes(distance)) + 
        geom_histogram(color = "black", fill = "gray70", bins = 30) + 
        geom_vline(xintercept = dis, color = "orange") +
        ylab("Frequency")+
        xlab("Manhattan Distance")+
        ggtitle(title)+

annotate("label",
         x = Inf, y = Inf,
         label = paste0("percentile: ", signif(percentile, 4), "\n",
                        "sigma: ", round(sigma, 2), "\n",
                        "p.value: ", signif((1 - pracma::erf(sigma / sqrt(2))) / 2, 3)),
         hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.1,         # nudges inward from top-right
         size =5,                        # larger text
         label.size = 0.5,                  # thicker border
         fill = "white",                    # background color
         color = "black",                   # text color
         fontface = "plain",                # normal weight
         family = "Helvetica",                  # optional: use serif font
         lineheight = 1.1                   # spacing between lines
)

    ps[[paste(i,j, sep = "-")]] <- cowplot::plot_grid(p1, nrow = 1,rel_widths = c(1))
        
     
    }
  }
  cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = ps, ncol = 1)
}
```

Comparing the enrichments directly, e.g. by merging two data.frames and plotting the log(p) in one vs the other highlighting top 5 for each 
```{r}
m <- merge(d.oo, d.sperm, by="motif_id", suffixes=c(".oocyte",".sperm"))

m.oo.sort <- m[order(m[,2],decreasing = FALSE),]
m.oo5 <- m.oo.sort[1:3,]
m.oo5$motif_alt <- gsub(x = m.oo5$motif_id,pattern = "\\_MOUSE.H11(.*)",replacement = "")

m.sperm.sort <- m[order(m[,18],decreasing = FALSE),]
m.sperm5 <- m.sperm.sort[1:3,]
m.sperm5$motif_alt <- gsub(x = m.sperm5$motif_id,pattern = "\\_MOUSE.H11(.*)",replacement = "")

m$motif_alt <- gsub(x = m$motif_id,pattern = "\\_MOUSE.H11(.*)",replacement = "")
```

```{r}
ggplot(m, aes(x=log2((1+tp.sperm)/(1+fp.sperm)), y= log2((1+tp.oocyte)/(1+fp.oocyte)), size=(tp_percent.sperm))) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_text_repel(box.padding=0.5, min.segment.length = 0, max.overlaps = 10, hjust = "left", aes(label=motif_alt), data=m.oo5, size=4) + 
  geom_text_repel(box.padding= 0.5, min.segment.length = 0, max.overlaps = 10, hjust = "right", aes(label=motif_alt), data=m.sperm5)+
  geom_point(color="orange", data=m.oo5) +
  geom_point(color="blue", data=m.sperm5) +
  labs(color="Top enriched motifs")+

  xlim(c(0,4.5))+
  ylim(c(0,4.5))+
  #ylab("-log10 (adjusted p-value MII oocyte)")+
  #xlab("-log10 (adjusted p-value spermatozoa)")+
  theme_classic() +
  #theme(legend.position = "none")+ 
  ggtitle("Top ranked motifs in peaks of spermatozoa vs. MII oocytes")
```

# Fig 1B - TF motif activity sperm vs oocyte

```{r}
core <- read_meme(file = "objects/HOCOMOCOv11_core_MOUSE_mono_meme_format.meme")


# original function PL
summary_core <- universalmotif::summarise_motifs(core)
core <- setNames(object = core,nm = summary_core$name)

motifs <- core
modf <- data.frame(row.names=summary_core$name,
                   TF=gsub("_MOUSE.H11MO...+","",summary_core$name),
                   grade=gsub(".+\\.","",summary_core$name),
                   motif_rank = gsub("[^0123]+","",gsub(".*MO.",replacement = "",summary_core$name))) #gsub("[^ro]+", "", str1)
modf <- modf[order(modf$TF,modf$grade,modf$motif_rank),]
modf <- modf[!duplicated(modf$TF),]
modf <- modf[!modf$grade == "D",]
motifs <- setNames(universalmotif::convert_motifs(motifs[row.names(modf)]), modf$TF)
```

# Fig 1F GR-ChIP GO:BP overrepresentation analysis

action required
```{r}
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
```



```{r}
se <- readRDS("intern_data/ChIP/GR_counts_non_resized.SE.rds")
ah <- AnnotationHub()
genome <- ah[["AH89457"]]

annGR <- transcripts(genome,
 columns = c("tx_id", "tx_biotype", "gene_id", "gene_name")
)


anno_Stress <- ChIPpeakAnno::annoPeaks(peaks = granges(se),annoData = annGR,bindingType = "fullRange",select = "bestOne")

# table(width(peaks)<=500)
```


```{r}
set.seed(123)
 

  gene_list <- unlist(anno_Stress$gene_name)
  gene_list <- gene_list[!duplicated(gene_list)]
  
kegg <- enrichGO(gene          = gene_list,
                OrgDb         = org.Mm.eg.db,
                keyType       = "SYMBOL",
                ont           = "BP",  # BP: Biological Process, MF: Molecular Function, CC: Cellular Component
                pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                pvalueCutoff  = 1,
                qvalueCutoff  = 1
                 
                    )


  
  

d <- dotplot(kegg, showCategory=10)
print(d)+ggtitle("GO:BP GR-Peaks Top10")
# kegg@result
ggsave("plots/Fig1F_GOBP_GRChIP.png")
ggsave("plots/Fig1F_GOBP_GRChIP.pdf")
#kegg@result  
```

# Fig 2F 2cellEmbryo Treatment effect of KH103 volcano
action required!
```{r}
se <- readRDS("objects/MK_EXP20.1_ProtacEmbryo_merged.SE.rds")

protac <- rowData(se)[[3]]



protac$Gene <- rownames(protac)


# List of dataframes
df_list <- list("KH-103" = protac)

# Function to generate volcano plots
generate_volcano_plot <- function(df, title) {
  df$highlight <- df$FDR < 0.1
  top_genes <- df[order(df$FDR), ][1:10, ]
  ggplot(df, aes(x=logFC, y=-log10(FDR))) +
    geom_point(aes(color = highlight)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "orange", "FALSE" = "black")) +
    geom_text_repel(data = subset(top_genes, highlight == TRUE), aes(label=Gene), size=3.5, min.segment.length = 0, max.overlaps = Inf, nudge_y = 0.1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(0.05), linetype="dashed")+
    xlab("logFC") +
    ylab("-log10(adjusted p-value)") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position="none") +
    ggtitle(title)
}

# Apply the function to each dataframe in the list
plots <- lapply(names(df_list), function(name) {
  generate_volcano_plot(df_list[[name]], paste("Differentially expressed genes in 2-cell embryos upon ", name, " treatment"))
})

print(plots)



# openxlsx::write.xlsx(protac,file = "objects/DEA_e2c_KH103.xlsx",rowNames = T)
```

```{r}
# Function to generate volcano plots
generate_volcano_plot <- function(df, title) {
  df$highlight <- df$FDR < 0.05
  # df$extreme[df$logFC > xlim[2] | df$logFC < xlim[1] | -log10(df$FDR) > ylim[2] | -log10(df$FDR) < ylim[1]] <- "extreme"
  df$highlight[df$extreme == "extreme"] <- "extreme"
  top_genes <- df[df$FDR < 0.05,]
  ggplot(df, aes(x=logFC, y=-log10(FDR))) +
    geom_point(aes(color = highlight)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "orange", "FALSE" = "black")) +
    geom_text_repel(data = subset(top_genes, highlight == TRUE ), aes(label=GeneAnno), size=3.5, min.segment.length = 0, max.overlaps = Inf, nudge_y = 0.1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(0.05), linetype="dashed")+
    xlab("logFC") +
    ylab("-log10(adjusted p-value)") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position="none") +
    ggtitle(title)
}
```

```{r}
library(scales)
dea <- Results$Total_IFSvsCTRL
table(dea$FDR < 0.05)

xlim <- c(-7, 7)
ylim <- c(0,8)

# Function to generate volcano plots
generate_volcano_plot <- function(df, title) {
  df$highlight <- df$FDR < 0.01
  df$extreme[df$logFC > xlim[2] | df$logFC < xlim[1] | -log10(df$FDR) > ylim[2] | -log10(df$FDR) < ylim[1]] <- "extreme"
  df$highlight[df$extreme == "extreme"] <- "extreme"
  top_genes <- df[order(df$FDR), ][1:20, ]
  ggplot(df, aes(x=logFC, y=-log10(FDR))) +
    geom_point(aes(color = highlight)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "orange", "FALSE" = "black", "extreme" = "firebrick3")) +
    geom_text_repel(data = subset(top_genes, highlight == TRUE | highlight == "extreme"), aes(label=ID), size=4, min.segment.length = 0, max.overlaps = Inf, nudge_y = 0.1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(0.05), linetype="dashed")+
    xlab("logFC") +
    ylab("-log10(adjusted p-value)") +
    # theme_classic() +
  
    scale_x_continuous(limits = xlim, oob = squish) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = ylim, oob = squish) +
    ggtitle(title)+
    theme(
  text       = element_text(size = 12),
  axis.text  = element_text(size = 12),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
  plot.title = element_text(size = 14),
  legend.position = "none"
)
}

# Apply the function to each dataframe in the list
generate_volcano_plot(dea, "Differentially expressed genes in Stress vs Ctrl 2-cell embryos")
```

## Fig S3C Motif activity analysis of GR-ChIP sperm IFS
action required (object files)

```{r}
df <- readRDS("objects/GRChIPArche_Results.DF.rds")
```
```{r}
library(scales)


xlim <- c(-7, 7)
ylim <- c(0,6)

# Function to generate volcano plots
generate_volcano_plot <- function(df, title) {
  df$highlight <- df$adj.P.Val < 0.05
  # df$extreme[df$logFC > xlim[2] | df$logFC < xlim[1] | -log10(df$FDR) > ylim[2] | -log10(df$FDR) < ylim[1]] <- "extreme"
  # df$highlight[df$extreme == "extreme"] <- "extreme"
  top_genes <- df[1:2,]
  ggplot(df, aes(x=logFC, y=-log10(adj.P.Val))) +
    geom_point(aes(color = highlight)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "orange", "FALSE" = "black")) +
    geom_text_repel(data = top_genes, aes(label=archetype), size=3.5, min.segment.length = 0, max.overlaps = Inf, nudge_y = 0.1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(0.05), linetype="dashed")+
    xlab("logFC") +
    ylab("-log10(adjusted p-value)") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position="none") +
    ggtitle(title)
}

# Apply the function to each dataframe in the list
generate_volcano_plot(df, "MotifActivity (Archetypes) of GR-ChIP in Stress vs Ctrl")
ggsave("plots/FigS3C_MotifAct_GRChIP_volcano.svg")
ggsave("plots/FigS3C_MotifAct_GRChIP_volcano.pdf")
ggsave("plots/FigS3C_MotifAct_GRChIP_volcano.png")
```

```{r}
generate_volcano_plot <- function(df, title) {
  df$highlight <- df$adj.P.Val < 0.05
  top_genes <- df[order(df$adj.P.Val), ][1:10, ]
  ggplot(df, aes(x=logFC, y=-log10(adj.P.Val))) +
    geom_point(aes(color = highlight)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "orange", "FALSE" = "black")) +
    # geom_text_repel(data = subset(top_genes, highlight == TRUE), aes(label=Gene), size=3.5, min.segment.length = 0, max.overlaps = Inf, nudge_y = 0.1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(0.05), linetype="dashed")+
    xlab("logFC") +
    ylab("-log10(adjusted p-value)") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position="none") +
    ggtitle(title)
}
```

## Fig S5C GSEA of offspring HC transcriptome originating from KH103 treated sperm


```{r}
dir_path <- "objects/"
files <- list.files(path = dir_path, pattern = "^fgsea_.*", full.names = TRUE)


```


```{r}
  
get_top_table <- function(pattern = NULL, filelist, top_num){ 
  library(purrr)
  library(dplyr)

    # the pattern should be the the pattern of the pathway names that we want to extract
    # for example "C5:GP:BP"
    # top_num: how many top terms we extract from each contrast
    if (is.null(pattern)){
        top_list <- map_dfr(filelist, function(fpath) {
        df <- readRDS(fpath)
        df <- df[order(df$pval), ]
        df_top <- head(df, top_num)  # now choose top5 otherwise too many terms
        fname <- basename(fpath)
        label <- gsub("^fgsea_", "", fname)
        df_top %>%
            mutate(source_file = fname,
                source = label,
                .before = 1)  # put source in column1
    })
    }
    else {
        top_list <- map_dfr(filelist, function(fpath) {
        df <- readRDS(fpath)
        df <- df[order(df$pval), ]
        df_top <- head(df[grepl(pattern, df$pathway),], top_num)  # extract the terms
        fname <- basename(fpath)
        label <- gsub("^fgsea_", "", fname)
        df_top %>%
            mutate(source_file = fname,
                source = label,
                .before = 1)  # put source at column1
})
    }

    top_path <- unique(top_list$pathway)
    fgsea_combine <- map_dfr(filelist, function(f){
        df <- readRDS(f)
        matched <- df %>% dplyr::filter(pathway %in% top_path)
        matched %>%
            mutate(
                label = gsub("^fgsea_", "", basename(f)),
                .before = 1)
    })

    fgsea_combine$label <- gsub("\\.rds$", "", fgsea_combine$label)
    
    return(fgsea_combine)
}
```



```{r}
fgsea_combine_GOBP <- get_top_table(pattern = "C5:GO:BP", filelist = files, top_num = 10)
fgsea_combine_GOBP$label <- factor(fgsea_combine_GOBP$label, levels = c(
        "total_stress_vs_ctrl", "total_PROTAC_vs_DMSO", "DMSO_interaction_between_sex_n_stress", "PROTAC_interaction_between_sex_n_stress"
    ))
```


```{r}
get_cluster <- function(maxK, fgsea_table){ # the function will decide the cluster number by itself (silhouette)
  library(tidyr)  
  # First: create a pathway x label matrix, the values are NES (we do the cluster based on NES)
    mat_df <- fgsea_table %>%
        dplyr::select(label, pathway, NES) %>%   
        pivot_wider(names_from = label, values_from = NES)
    mat <- as.matrix(mat_df %>% dplyr::select(-pathway))
    rownames(mat) <- mat_df$pathway

    # Second: compute the distance
    # Pearson correlation distance (1 - correlation): measures similarity in patterns, ignoring magnitude
    # Euclidean distance: measures absolute numeric differneces (magnitude)
    # here we care about the pattern across contrast groups, so we use the pearson correlation
    dist_mat <- as.dist(1 - cor(t(mat)))

    # Third: compute hierarchical clustering
    hc <- hclust(dist_mat, method = "ward.D2")  # ward.D2: join clusters that cause the smallest increase in within-cluster variance. good for forming compact balanced clusters from continuous data 

    # Fouth: use silhouette to check how many clusters are the best
    avg_sil <- numeric(maxK) 
    for(k in 3:maxK){  
        cl <- cutree(hc, k= k)
        sil <- cluster::silhouette(cl, dist_mat)
        avg_sil[k] <- mean(sil[,3])
    }
    best_k_sil <- which.max(avg_sil)

    plot(3:maxK, avg_sil[3:maxK], type="b", xlab="k", ylab="Average silhouette", pch=19)
    cat("Best k by silhouette =", best_k_sil, ", avg silhouette =", avg_sil[best_k_sil], "\n")

    pathway_order <- hc$labels[hc$order]
    clusters <- cutree(hc, k = best_k_sil)
    cluster_df <- tibble(pathway = names(clusters), cluster = as.factor(clusters))

    # Put the cluster result into the original table
    fgsea_clustered <- fgsea_table %>%
        left_join(cluster_df, by = "pathway") %>%
        mutate(pathway = factor(pathway, levels = pathway_order))

    return(fgsea_clustered)
}
```

```{r}
library(vegan); library(ggplot2); library(dplyr); library(tidyr)

# 1) Refit: only the term of interest, treatment and batch partialled out
cap2 <- capscale(dist_matrix ~ condition2 * sex + Condition(treatment + batch),
                 data = meta)

anova(cap2, by = "margin", permutations = how(nperm = 9999))  # confirm the interaction
RsquareAdj(cap2)
```


```{r}
# 2) Scores (3 constrained axes: condition2, sex, condition2:sex)
sc <- scores(cap2, display = "wa", choices = 1:3, scaling = 1) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("filename") |>
  left_join(meta, by = "filename")

# 3) Interaction plot: mean ± SE per condition2 x sex
cent <- sc |>
  pivot_longer(starts_with("CAP"), names_to = "axis", values_to = "score") |>
  group_by(condition2, sex, axis) |>
  summarise(m = mean(score), se = sd(score) / sqrt(n()), n = n(), .groups = "drop")


```
```{r}
# variance explained per axis (as % of total variance, not just of constrained)
eig  <- cap2$CCA$eig
tot  <- cap2$tot.chi
lab  <- sprintf("CAP%d (%.1f%% of total variance)", 1:length(eig), 100 * eig / tot)

# group centroids
cent <- sc |>
  group_by(condition2, sex) |>
  summarise(CAP1 = mean(CAP1), CAP2 = mean(CAP2), .groups = "drop")


sc$Condition <- sc$condition2
cent$Condition <- cent$condition2

cols <-  c(
    "Control" = "seashell4",
    "Stress" = "#ffa500ff")

p <- ggplot(sc, aes(CAP1, CAP2, colour = Condition, shape = sex)) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = interaction(Condition, sex)),
               level = 0.68, linewidth = 0.4, show.legend = F) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(data = cent, size = 5, stroke = 1.5, shape = 23,
             aes(fill = Condition), colour = "black") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cols) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
  labs(x = lab[1], y = lab[2]) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "grey60"))
```

## Fig S6D Covariate analysis for TADS-groups
```{r}
se <- readRDS("intern_data/ATAC_Hs/narrowPeaks_allHumanHighLow5.SE.rds")


# summary(assay(se)[,1])
se$names <- gsub(x = colnames(se),pattern = "\\_(.*)",replacement = "")
meta <- read.csv("intern_data/ATAC_Hs/meta.csv",sep = ",")



rownames(meta) <- meta$FB_ID
meta <- meta[complete.cases(meta),]
meta <- meta[se$names,]
colData(se) <- DataFrame(meta[se$names,])


rownames(se) <- as.character(granges(se))


```


```{r}
dds <- calcNormFactors(DGEList(assay(se)))
mm <- model.matrix(~0+TADS_group, data=as.data.frame(colData(se))); mm 
dds <- dds[filterByExpr(dds,group =  se$TADS_group, min.count=10),] 


se <- se[rownames(dds),]

# logCPM
assays(se)$logcpm <- log1p(edgeR::cpm(dds))

```

```{r}

# PCA: samples need to be rows
pca <- prcomp(t(assays(se)$logcpm), scale. = FALSE)

pcs <- as.data.frame(pca$x[, 1:5])
summary(pca)$importance[2, 1:5]


meta <- as.data.frame(colData(se))

dat <- cbind(meta, pcs)

dat$TADS_group      <- factor(dat$TADS_group)
dat$smoking_yes1_no0 <- factor(dat$smoking_yes1_no0)
dat$SequencingLane1  <- factor(dat$SequencingLane1)


```

```{r}
vars <- c(
    "Age_yhd",
    "smoking_yes1_no0",
    "alkohol_avg_daily",
    "Semen_vol_ml",
    "concentration_10exp6_ml",
    "SequencingLane1",
    "bmi_epig",
    "siviilisaaty_epig",
    "epdssum_epig",
    "sclsum_epig"
)

adjR2 <- sapply(paste0("PC", 1:5), function(pc) {
    sapply(vars, function(v) {
        fit <- lm(
            reformulate(v, response = pc),
            data = dat
        )
        summary(fit)$adj.r.squared
    })
})

round(adjR2, 2)
```
```{r}
pvals <- sapply(paste0("PC", 1:5), function(pc) {
    sapply(vars, function(v) {
        fit <- lm(reformulate(v, response = pc), data = dat)
        f <- summary(fit)$fstatistic
        pf(f[1], f[2], f[3], lower.tail = FALSE)
    })
})
```



```{r}
var_explained <- summary(pca)$importance[2, 1:5]

round(var_explained, 3)
```


```{r}
TADS_R2 <- sapply(vars, function(v) {
    fit <- lm(
        reformulate(v, response = "TADS_score"),
        data = dat
    )

    summary(fit)$adj.r.squared
   
})

res <- cbind(
    TADS = TADS_R2,
    adjR2
)

round(res, 2)
```
```{r}
TADS_p <- sapply(vars, function(v) {
    fit <- lm(reformulate(v, response = "TADS_score"), data = dat)
    f <- summary(fit)$fstatistic
    pf(f[1], f[2], f[3], lower.tail = FALSE)
})

res_p <- cbind(
    TADS = TADS_p,
    pvals
)

signif(res_p, 2)
round(res, 2)
```

```{r}
# pmat = p-value matrix, r2mat = adjusted R² matrix (same dims, same order)
pmat  <- as.matrix(res_p[,1:4])
r2mat <- as.matrix(res[,1:4])

rownames(pmat) <- c("age","smoking","alcohol","semen volume","semen conc.","seq. lane","BMI","civil status","depression score", "anxiety score")
rownames(r2mat) <-  c("age","smoking","alcohol","semen volume","semen conc.","seq. lane","BMI","civil status","depression score", "anxiety score")
# Ensure alignment: p-value rownames carry a ".value" suffix
rownames(pmat) <- sub("\\.value$", "", rownames(pmat))
pmat <- pmat[rownames(r2mat), colnames(r2mat)]

# Negative adj. R² = no explanatory power -> 0
mat <- pmax(r2mat, 0)
mat <- r2mat

```

```{r}
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)
alpha <- 0.1
plot_df <- as.data.frame(r2mat) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Covariate") %>%
  pivot_longer(-Covariate, names_to = "Outcome", values_to = "r2") %>%
  left_join(
    as.data.frame(pmat) %>%
      rownames_to_column("Covariate") %>%
      pivot_longer(-Covariate, names_to = "Outcome", values_to = "p"),
    by = c("Covariate", "Outcome")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    star  = !is.na(.data$p) & .data$p < alpha,
    label = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", r2), if_else(star, "*", "")),
    Covariate = factor(Covariate, levels = rev(rownames(r2mat))),
    Outcome   = factor(Outcome, levels = colnames(r2mat))
  )

lim <- max(abs(plot_df$r2))

ggplot(plot_df, aes(Outcome, Covariate, fill = r2)) +
  geom_tile(color = "grey85") +
  geom_text(aes(label = label, fontface = if_else(star, "bold", "plain")),
            size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B",
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-lim, lim), name = "Adj. R²") +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
       title = "Variance explained by covariates",
       subtitle = paste0("* p < ", alpha)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        plot.title.position = "plot")

ggsave("plots/FigS6D_covariate_variance_matrix.png")
# ggsave("plots/FigS6D_covariate_variance_matrix.pdf")
# ggsave("plots/FigS6D_covariate_variance_matrix.svg")
```

```{r}
set.seed(1)  # permutation p-values are random; fix the seed for reproducibility
nperm <- 9999  # 999 is too coarse for p-values near 0.05

run <- function(f) adonis2(f, data = meta, permutations = nperm, by = "margin")

fits <- list(
  "No covariates"            = run(d ~ TADS_group),
  "Lane"                     = run(d ~ TADS_group + SequencingLane1),
  "Lane + alcohol"           = run(d ~ TADS_group + SequencingLane1 + alkohol_avg_daily),
  "Lane + smoking"           = run(d ~ TADS_group + SequencingLane1 + smoking_yes1_no0),
  "Lane + alcohol + smoking" = run(d ~ TADS_group + SequencingLane1 +
                                     alkohol_avg_daily + smoking_yes1_no0),
  # "Lane + SCL"               = run(d ~ TADS_group + SequencingLane1 + sclsum_epig),
  "Lane + semen volume"      = run(d ~ TADS_group + SequencingLane1 + Semen_vol_ml)
)



# One tidy object with everything
adonis_res <- purrr::imap_dfr(fits, function(fit, model) {
  as.data.frame(fit) %>%
    rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!term %in% c("Residual", "Total")) %>%
    transmute(Model = model, term, R2, p = `Pr(>F)`)
}) %>%
  mutate(
    Variable = recode(term,
      TADS_group        = "TADS",
      SequencingLane1   = "Sequencing lane",
      alkohol_avg_daily = "Alcohol",
      smoking_yes1_no0  = "Smoking",
      # sclsum_epig       = "SCL-90",
      Semen_vol_ml      = "Semen volume"),
    Model = factor(Model, levels = names(fits)),
    sig = case_when(p < 0.001 ~ "***", p < 0.01 ~ "**",
                    p < 0.05 ~ "*", p < 0.1 ~ ".", TRUE ~ "")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Model, Variable, R2, p, sig)

```

```{r}
adonis_res %>%
  dplyr::filter(Variable == "TADS") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Model, R2), y = R2)) +
  
  geom_col(
    aes(fill = p < 0.05),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(
      "R² = ", sprintf("%.3f", R2),
      "\np = ", sprintf("%.3f", p)
    )),
    hjust = -0.05,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  
  coord_flip() +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = "grey70", "TRUE" = "#D55E00"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  
  expand_limits(y = 0.105) +
  
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = expression("Marginal TADS " * R^2),
    title = "TADS effect across covariate-adjusted PERMANOVA models"
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)
```
